description.value: Manila BBQ Supermart is a Filipino grocery store and international money remittance centre that evolved from a restaurant originally serving the Filipino immigrant community in the 1990s. In late 2020 it relocated to a larger space in New Westminster and expanded its product lineup to include daily staples alongside a wide array of Filipino, Korean, Vietnamese, Chinese, and other Asian specialty goods. A touring cyclist passing through New Westminster would find it a useful resupply stop for basics as well as a distinctively stocked pantry of frozen fish, snacks, and imported goods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Manila BBQ Supermart is an active Filipino grocery and remittance store at 615 12th St, New Westminster — but the OSM community field says 'Vancouver', which is a different city. The website documents a broad range of grocery products including daily staples (eggs, milk, bread, sugar, spices), frozen items, and Asian specialty goods, confirming Basic groceries. No website or OSM evidence mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, ice, or any cycling-specific amenity.
